scope: Per-profile HBM admission for GLM-5.3 FP8 on eight hosts / 32 TPU v4 chips. Interface and capacity evidence only; no accuracy claim and no new benchmark.

cache_geometry.note: The MLA-compressed cache is sharded eight ways; the prefill program holds an argument and an output copy, so a capacity change moves roughly twice this rate.

profiles.failure: XLA compilation ran out of HBM during the batched prefill program
profiles.note: A September 2026 GLM-5.2-era research run at 262656 slots reported estimate_fits with 1.14 GB headroom. GLM-5.3's FP8 weights consume that margin, so the earlier result does not carry over. The fleet cleaned up and both workload leases were released.

limits: Decode rates are single-answer slowest-host measurements, not a benchmark
The 166912 admission is one completed answer, not a quality or long-input claim
Capacity is compiled in at load; changing it requires unloading the resident model
Estimated break-even for admission is near 216000 slots; values between 166912 and 262144 are untested
